title: AI Is Wiping Out All These Jobs
description: AI is already taking jobs that felt safe just two years ago, and the next ones in line are the jobs people swear a machine could never do.

We walk through the 121,401 job cuts employers blamed on AI in 2026 through October, where robots really stand in welding and home repair, and why 70% of Americans expect AI to cut jobs while only 30% worry about their own.
